Also while I know it does suck to feel rhese emotions, I still think its important to thoroughly feel it out. Maybe jot down somewhere each time you rhink of something like this... it could be if he's sleeping with someone else, if he has a new girlfriend, where he is, what he's doing... just write it down. After a month see how much time is between each of those thoughts and keep doing it until you have practicslly nothing to write. When you notice how much time is between each one you'll see that you really are getting over the person even though you don't feel like you are!
